Libraries used

```{r}
# two of the required packages are installed from GitHub
# library(remotes)
# remotes::install_github("EDIorg/EMLassemblyline")
# remotes::install_github("WHOIGit/ediutilities")

library(EMLassemblyline)
library(ediutilities)
library(here)
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

```

Read data table

```{r}
data_table <- read.csv(here('nes-lter-poc-transect-input.csv'))
data_table$date_time_utc = ymd_hms(data_table$date)
data_table <- data_table |> arrange(date_time_utc)

data_table <- data_table |>
  mutate(POC_micromolar = case_when(C_quality_flag == 6 ~ 0, TRUE ~ POC_micromolar)) |>
  mutate(POC_microg_perL = case_when(C_quality_flag == 6 ~ 0, TRUE ~ POC_microg_perL)) |>
  mutate(PON_micromolar = case_when(N_quality_flag == 6 ~ 0, TRUE ~ PON_micromolar)) |>
  mutate(PON_microg_perL = case_when(N_quality_flag == 6 ~ 0, TRUE ~ PON_microg_perL)) |>
  mutate(C_to_N_molar_ratio = case_when(C_quality_flag == 6 ~ NA, TRUE ~ C_to_N_molar_ratio))

write.csv(data_table,'nes-lter-poc-transect.csv', na = "NaN", row.names=FALSE)

```

Basic plots

```{r}

data_table$C_quality_flag <- as.factor(data_table$C_quality_flag)
data_table$N_quality_flag <- as.factor(data_table$N_quality_flag)

ggplot(data_table, aes(x = date_time_utc, y = POC_microg_perL, color = C_quality_flag)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo")+
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(data_table, aes(x = date_time_utc, y = PON_microg_perL, color = N_quality_flag)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo")+
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(data_table, aes(x = date_time_utc, y = C_to_N_molar_ratio, color = N_quality_flag)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo")+
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  theme_minimal()

```


Plot to check coordinates

```{r}

# Map extent from the underway track, with a small margin
pad <- 0.15
lon_lim <- range(data_table$longitude) + c(-pad*4, pad*4)
lat_lim <- range(data_table$latitude) + c(-pad, pad)

coast <- map_data('usa')

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = data_table, aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, color = POC_micromolar), size = 1) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = 'POC (micromoles/L)') +
  geom_polygon(data = coast, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = 'gray80', color = 'gray40', linewidth = 0.3) +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)) +
  coord_quickmap(xlim = lon_lim, ylim = lat_lim) +
  labs(x = 'Longitude', y = 'Latitude')

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = data_table, aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, color = PON_micromolar), size = 1) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = 'PON (micromoles/L)') +
  geom_polygon(data = coast, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = 'gray80', color = 'gray40', linewidth = 0.3) +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)) +
  coord_quickmap(xlim = lon_lim, ylim = lat_lim) +
  labs(x = 'Longitude', y = 'Latitude')

```
Read the Excel metadata template and generate text templates used by
EMLassemblyline

```{r}

excel_to_template(here('nes-lter-poc-transect-info'), 'nes-lter-poc-transect', rights='CC0', file_type = ".md")

```
Generate the package and insert the parent project node into the resulting EML

```{r}
# add package ID
pkg_id <- 'knb-lter-nes.27.4'

make_eml(here(),
         dataset.title='Particulate organic carbon (POC) and nitrogen (PON) from Northeast U.S. Shelf Long Term Ecological Research (NES-LTER) Transect cruises, ongoing since 2017',
         data.table='nes-lter-poc-transect.csv',
         data.table.description='NES-LTER transect POC and PON data',
         data.table.name = 'nes-lter-poc-transect',
         temporal.coverage = temporal_coverage(data_table$date),
         geographic.description = "NES-LTER Transect",
         geographic.coordinates = geographic_coordinates(data_table$latitude, data_table$longitude),
         maintenance.description = "ongoing",
         user.id = "NES",
         user.domain = "LTER",
         package.id = pkg_id)

project_insert(pkg_id, "parent_project_NESI-II_RAPID.txt")

```
